prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en mor- eller farförälder". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "grandparent".
Scene: A child enjoying an affectionate conversation with an older grandparent, family-photo setting.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "mor- and farföräldrar are grandparents on either side.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "En mor- eller farförälder kan betyda mycket för ett barn.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
